Definition: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)
BiblicalUsage: 1) statute, ordinance, limit, something prescribed, due; 1a) prescribed task; 1b) prescribed portion; 1c) action prescribed (for oneself), resolve; 1d) prescribed due; 1e) prescribed limit, boundary; 1f) enactment, decree, ordinance; 1f1) specific decree; 1f2) law in general; 1g) enactments, statutes; 1g1) conditions; 1g2) enactments; 1g3) decrees; 1g4) civil enactments prescribed by God
